description: This file defines an authentication context for a React application, including state management for user authentication status, user profile, token storage, and login/logout functions. It uses React hooks, context API, and interacts with API endpoints for authentication.

methods.name: getStoredToken
methods.description: Retrieves stored JWT token from localStorage if available.

methods.name: setStoredToken
methods.description: Stores or removes JWT token in localStorage.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React component providing authentication context to child components.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access authentication context.
